releaseNotes: Restores whole-pile Auto Farm roaming instead of restricting digging to upper edges or pinning the route to the estimated needle/key location. Tracks 16 angular sectors across three height and three radial bands, keeps roughly 2.5 seconds of digging per point, and revisits live hay even above the reveal-depth threshold. Rare/RGB priority is no longer globally disabled by hidden-target protection; wide-tool/TNT protection is local to the target region. Preserves TNT low-arc aiming and Basement puzzle automation.
